## Goal
distro/homebrew/freemyid.rb: a Homebrew formula installing freemyid from the PyPI sdist into a virtualenv (Language::Python::Virtualenv). Version from pyproject.toml; sha256 left as a clearly marked placeholder for the release tooling (you have no network). distro/homebrew/README.md: how the tap will be published (in-house does it).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Recipe follows the packaging system's current conventions; version read from pyproject.toml; no network was needed.
- Note in VENDOR_STATUS.md anything you could not verify offline.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).
